origin.description: This function returns the order n creation matrix, a square matrix with the sequence 1, 2, ..., n - 1 on the sub-diagonal below the principal diagonal.
origin.details: The order n creation matrix is also called the derivation matrix and is used in numerical mathematics and physics. It arises in the solution of linear dynamical systems. The form of the matrix is a zero matrix with k on row k + 1 and column k for k = 1, ..., n - 1.
